note: Declares the reviewed payload-strip decisions: which upstream directories tools/materialize_llvm_payload.py must skip when reproducing the payload from a full checkout of the pinned commit, and which retained files this repo deliberately patches away from upstream content. provenance/llvm-source-closure.json remains the sole authority over exact file contents/hashes; this file records intent, so the reproducer and tools/verify.py honour the prune and patch decisions instead of silently reverting them.

removes add_subdirectory calls for the pruned llvm/lib/* directories

link-speed: PDB symbol merging analyzes objects in parallel and publishes serially in input order; section-contribution CRCs computed in parallel and first-contribution CRC no longer recomputed; PROCREF globals pre-serialized on worker threads; public symbol records built in parallel. Output bytes unchanged.
link-speed: .debug$S flag scan (S_OBJNAME/S_COMPILE3) walks record prefixes directly and is deferred to a parallel pass in the writer for non-PCH objects. Output bytes unchanged.
link-speed: ObjFile::finishDeferredFlags/flagsDeferred for the deferred .debug$S flag scan.
link-speed: runs the deferred .debug$S flag scan for all objects in parallel at the start of Writer::run, before hotPatchable is read.
link-speed: publics/globals record streams written in 1 MiB batches instead of one block-mapped write per record; globals bucket name extraction in parallel. Output bytes unchanged.
link-speed: slice-by-8 CRC-32 replacing the byte-at-a-time table loop (same polynomial and tables; identical results).
